references.title: Hand spectroscopes collection
references.evidence: Penrose specimen: rotating end adjusts slit and friction draw tube focuses; Hilger 90–115 mm; Leitz 90–110 mm with three prisms and achromat. Basis is typology, not an exact Penrose/Beck copy.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.

references.title: Handheld Prism Spectroscope
references.evidence: Supplementary general construction. Its red-compressed/violet-expanded text agrees with Lotus but conflicts with Skyjems Beck page. Wavelength scale claim is not applied to this basic model.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.

references.title: Beck Spectroscope
references.evidence: Supplement only: Amici/direct-vision concept. Its violet-compressed/red-expanded claim conflicts with Lotus and its own handheld page and is not adopted; historical Beck is not asserted to have three prisms.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.

references.title: Gem Testing with the Spectroscope
references.evidence: Diffraction models have fixed slit and balanced spacing. Prism spectra expand violet and compress red. Historical Beck model described as five-prism; present three-prism count is an explicitly illustrative Amici choice.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.

references.title: OPL Pocket Diffraction Grating Spectroscope
references.evidence: Comparable pocket type is 55 mm long and 12.5 mm wide, with fixed slit/focus. The asset uses requested illustrative 55 mm x 14.5 mm; 14.5 mm is not a GIA or OPL measured specification.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.
